subject: Re: MAP-linked private offer for AcmeCorp — evaluation, commit, and ramp milestones
messages:
From: Sam Green <sam.green@amazon.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: Private offer & MAP for AcmeCorp evaluation

Hi Rishi / Marissa —

AWS here. Per our call last week, AcmeCorp wants to move evaluation -> committed capacity via a private offer. I attached the standard AWS private-offer template (AWS_PO_Template.pdf).

High level ask: can Redwood provide a MAP (mutual action plan) that ties evaluation milestones (POC completion, ramp week 1, month-1 ramp) to pricing/commit tiers for the private offer? AWS Procurement wants clear milestone-based triggers in the PO so they can approve the internal chargeback.

Example we discussed: 30-day POC with $X credit; if POC passes, customer signs a 12-month private offer commit at tiered discounts based on quarterly ramp volumes. We need:
- A short MAP doc with milestone definitions and deliverables
- A proposed pricing ladder (commits -> discounts -> ramp triggers) you can live with
- Any attestation language needed for the PO (data residency, SOC2, audit logs)

Can you send a draft MAP and a recommended private-offer pricing stepdown by EOW (Fri)? I can push the PO draft on our side once we have your input.

Thanks,
Sam
Partner Development — AWS Marketplace
Attachments: AWS_PO_Template.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Intro: Private offer & MAP for AcmeCorp evaluation

Folks — forwarding Sam's request. Can we pull together:
- MAP_Acme_v1.pdf: 4-step MAP (POC success criteria, security review, private-offer signature, ramp/enablement)
- Eval_plan_Acme.xlsx: expected token/embedding volumes by week for 90-day evaluation
- Proposed pricing ladder tied to commit: 0-250k tokens/mo = list, 250k-1M = 10% off, 1M-5M = 20% off, 5M+ = 30% off. We should show an accelerated discount once they sign a 12mo commit after successful POC.

Monica: please include SOC2 + data residency callouts in the MAP appendix; procurement will flag these. Marissa: can you draft a short paragraph that maps POC acceptance criteria to a trigger that AWS can use in the PO (e.g., "POC accepted when model outputs meet the agreed eval benchmarks in Eval Plan sheet").

I'll take pricing language and the ramp schedule. Goal: have the MAP + pricing ladder back to Sam by EOW so AWS can draft the private offer.

Thanks — R
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

From: Sam Green <sam.green@amazon.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Tue, 19 May 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Private offer & MAP for AcmeCorp evaluation

Thanks Rishi — this is perfect. Attaching a first-pass Private_Offer_Draft.docx that reflects AWS's standard clause set and a place to insert your MAP reference (Private_Offer_Draft.docx). A couple of notes from Acme procurement:
- They want the PO to reference the MAP milestone "POC accepted" as the trigger for the first committed billing cycle.
- Discount ladder is fine but they prefer an upfront commit for Q1 to secure the 20% tier; we can structure it so the 12-month commit is executed within 30 days of POC acceptance.
- Billing: they prefer NET30 and consolidated monthly invoicing via AWS.
- Security: they will attach a security questionnaire; please confirm SOC2 and retention period for KV cache keys.

If you can slot the MAP file name into the private offer and return the doc, I can route it through AWS legal and then generate a Private Offer on the marketplace.

Sam
Attachments: Private_Offer_Draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sam Green <sam.green@amazon.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Private offer & MAP for AcmeCorp evaluation

Sam / Acme procurement — attaching MAP_Acme_v1.pdf and Eval_plan_Acme.xlsx. Highlights and proposed tweaks to your draft PO: 

- MAP milestones (section 2):
  * Milestone 1 (Kickoff): shared runbook and access (Day 0)
  * Milestone 2 (POC validation): Acceptance when Eval plan bench passes (within 30 days of data ingestion) — triggers ability to sign/execute private offer signature and first billing cycle
  * Milestone 3 (Private Offer execution): commit executed within 30 days of Milestone 2 to lock discount tier
  * Milestone 4 (Ramp): predefined weekly burst schedule for month 1 -> month 3 to reach committed QPS/throughput

- Pricing ladder we propose to insert into PO (linked to commit buckets):
  * Up to 250k tokens/mo — list price
  * 250k-1M tokens/mo — 10% off list
  * 1M-5M tokens/mo — 20% off list
  * 5M+ tokens/mo — 30% off list

We also propose a 60-day "grace" credit if POC fails for reasons in Redwood's control (engineering regressions) — this should live in the PO exceptions.

Security callouts (Monica): Redwood confirms SOC2 Type II in scope for inference and retains audit logs for 13 months; KV cache retention configurable, default 30 days; we can add data-residency ATO language for regional AWS endpoints.

Next steps: Sam, if AWS legal can inject the MAP reference and generate the Private Offer link, we will:
1) Have Acme sign the MAP (non-binding action plan) and accept Eval plan
2) Acme signs the Private Offer (12mo commit) within 30d of POC acceptance to get the agreed tiered discount
3) Kick off enablement and ramp week schedule

Quoting your note below:
> "If you can slot the MAP file name into the private offer and return the doc, I can route it through AWS legal and then generate a Private Offer on the marketplace."

We will review any redlines quickly — Marissa will own contract sync.

Best,
Rishi
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP_Acme_v1.pdf, Eval_plan_Acme.xlsx

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acme.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Sam Green <sam.green@amazon.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: Private offer & MAP for AcmeCorp evaluation

Thanks everyone — Acme procurement here. A few clarifying items before we proceed to legal: 

1) Can you confirm the billing cadence and invoice recipient? We need consolidated monthly billing to be routed to procurement@acme.com (NET30).
2) Please confirm Redwood's SOC2 scope and the retention period for request/response logs and KV cache. We attached our Acme_Security_Questionnaire.pdf for you to review — we'll need it back filled.
3) On the MAP: agree on POC acceptance criteria but need the Eval_plan_Acme.xlsx to contain 3 concrete test prompts and pass thresholds.

If you can return the completed questionnaire and an updated PO with MAP reference and billing language by Friday COB, procurement will route to legal and aim to sign within two business days.

Elena Ruiz
Head of Procurement, AcmeCorp
Attachments: Acme_Security_Questionnaire.pdf (application/pdf)
